model: PRO3 three-phase energy meter (2026 PRO line)
aliases: PRO3 1U AC 100A Mod T Ba MID
applies_to: PRO3-Mod (art. 1301) and PRO3-Mod-Ba (art. 1302, with RTC tariffs) from the 2026 PRO3 user manual version 1.3; the PRO3-S has no Modbus.
summary: The PRO3 is a MID-certified three-phase 100 A DIN-rail energy meter from inepro's 2026 PRO line; the -Mod versions add an RS485 Modbus RTU port. Live values are IEEE 754 floats (high word first) in input registers from hex 5000h, energy counters sit from 6000h and settings from 4000h. This map covers the default register map: instantaneous values, THD, demand peaks, energy totals and tariff registers (as floats) and the main communication and display settings.

addressing.note: The map prints hex addresses that go into the request unchanged; the manual's example frames are 01 06 4003 000A (set Modbus ID) and 01 10 5060 0002 ... (reset demand peak). So 5012h is wire address 20498. Rows typed 'input' are read with function 04; rows typed 'input /holding' are listed here as holding registers (read 03, write 06/16).

source.title: PRO3 energy meter - Full User Manual EN
source.pages: Modbus spec p. 9; terminals p. 13; comm settings p. 37; default register map pp. 42-50; data-format note p. 62; writable registers pp. 63-65

notes: This file covers only the 'Default' register map. The manual also prints an 'Extensive' map (from 0000h, W/var units) and a 'YTL' map (scaled integers and UINT64 counters). The display has a 'Modbus Mapping' setting (0/1/2, default 2) but the manual does not say which number selects which map, so check that the meter answers at 5000h before relying on this file.

Energy registers are typed 'UINT32/Float ABCD' (or INT32/Float) with units 'Wh/kWh'. Register 4026h selects the format: 1 = INT32 (default), 2 = FLOAT. They are listed here as FLOAT32 in kWh/kvarh/kVAh, valid only after writing 2 to 4026h. The INT32 mode is not covered because the manual never states its scale explicitly.
The INT32/FLOAT pairing with Wh/kWh follows the order printed in the type and unit columns ('UINT32/Float', 'Wh/kWh'); the same manual's Extensive map also gives float energy in kWh.
Registers marked 'Only for Ba version with RTC' (RTC tariff and some quadrant energies) read 0 on meters without the RTC; the manual says unsupported registers stay readable and return 0.

Left out: serial number, meter code and CRC (BCD/HEX/ASCII with no decoding given), RTC time and tariff tables (BCD blocks), current direction (ASCII), S0 output rate (typed UINT16 length 1 in the read map but FLOAT length 2 in the write table), CT ratio, tariff mode 6048h (listed twice with different meanings), LCD password and the resettable day counter (INT32 without a stated word order).
Quadrant labels on the DS-T1/DS-T2 rows are copied as printed; some pair import/export with Q2/Q3 differently from the totals rows.
Baud rates per the manual: 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600 and 115200 (the spec table on p. 9 prints 76800 instead of 57600). Stop bits: 1 with even/odd parity, 2 with no parity.
This 2026 PRO line uses a different template from the older PRO1-Mod/PRO2-Mod (V3.x) and PRO380-Mod maps; do not mix them.

integration.summary: Wire RS485 to terminals 12 (A) and 13 (B), poll unit 1 at 9600 baud 8E1 with function 04 and decode live values as high-word-first floats from 5000h. Write 2 to 4026h once (function 06) so the 6000h energy registers come back as floats.
integration.enable: Modbus is only on the -Mod and -Mod-Ba versions. Set ID, baud and parity on the display, with inepro's configuration software, or over Modbus at 4003h/4004h/4011h.
quirks: Addresses are hex: 5012h is decimal 20498 on the wire.
Live values are input registers (function 04), not holding registers.
Power is in kW/kvar/kVA, not W.
Energy registers default to INT32; set 4026h = 2 for floats.
Baud rate is written as a code (6 = 9600 ... 10 = 115200), not as the number.
setup: Defaults: Modbus ID 1, 9600 baud, even parity, 1 stop bit.
Parity codes at 4011h: 1 = even, 2 = none, 3 = odd; use 2 stop bits with no parity.
Up to 60 devices per RS485 bus, 1200 m range, fewer at higher baud rates.
gotchas: Total active energy (6000h) depends on the combination code at 400Fh; read forward (600Ch) and reverse (6018h) for import and export.
RTC tariff registers read 0 unless the meter is a -Mod-Ba.
Combination code E (value 5, net forward - reverse) locks permanently once programmed.
